senses.gloss: m. (δίσκος) disc (always used in the sense of tabula, tabella),

units: <cite ref="Menachot 40a">Men. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>ליכתביה אד׳</he> (Rashi <he>אדיסקי׳</he>, Ms. R. 2 a. K. <cite ref="A03173"><he>אר׳</he></cite>) let it be published on public tablets (inscriptions; comment.: in official letters from Palestine to Babylon, v. infra).

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 112b:7">B. Kam. 112ᵇ</cite> <he>נקיט ד׳ מב״ד וכ׳</he> (M. M. <cite ref="T00664"><he>ריסקא</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) he held a letter from the Supreme Court (authorizing him to take depositions of witnesses).

<cite ref="Kiddushin 70a">Kidd. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>ד׳ דזמינותא</he> Ar. (ed. <he>פיתקא דהזמנא</he>, <cite ref="Q00766"><he>פיסקא</he></cite>) summons to appear before court. Ib.ᵇ, v. <cite ref="D00939"><he>דַּסְקָא</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>דִּיסְקֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Gittin 36a">Gitt. 36ᵃ</cite> their signatures in the shape of figures (as a fish, bough &c.) were known to the public <he>בדסקי</he> (Rashi <he>בדיס׳</he>, Ar. <he>בדייס׳</he>) by the official letters which they issued. Ib. 88ᵃ <he>רב בדי׳ וכ׳</he> (Ar. <he>בדיי׳</he>) Rab put his signature sideways only in official letters.—[<he>דיסקאות</he>, v. <cite ref="D00659"><he>דִּיסַקְיָא</he></cite>.]
